parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part of the scissors includes one blade and its attached handle, typically made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism and provides a grip for the user to apply force during cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint to open and close against the other blade handle set, enabling the cutting action.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is the second blade and handle assembly of the scissors, also made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It complements the first blade handle set to form the complete cutting pair, providing the opposing edge for shearing materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots relative to the first blade handle set around the central joint, creating the scissor’s cutting motion.
